title: Classify binary C5 optima at total payload seven (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Finite classification certificate: positive total-seven binary C5 fitting matrices have exactly 1, 51 and 6 rank-optimal local-similarity classes in the three width profiles. Only 1, 5 and 2 classes have integral edge/private-channel form. All 58 canonical representatives are supplied; 50 are nonchannel classes.

```text
widths         local classes    edge/private classes
(3,1,1,1,1)          1                   1
(2,2,1,1,1)         51                   5
(2,1,2,1,1)          6                   2
```

Equivalence is block-diagonal similarity with labeled cycle vertices. Rotation/reflection reduces the width patterns to these three profiles; vertex automorphisms are not additionally quotiented. Arbitrary directed rectangular neighbor blocks are allowed, with identity diagonal blocks and both ordered nonedge blocks zero.

This answers the binary part of JoyboyBrian #5215's explicit total-seven question. #5215, JoyboyBrian #5023 and Nick Petalas #5180/#3248 are cited predecessors, not replay targets. Credit Tekalign, Sagar Thakrar, ywz65, Cinna Davis, Adam Gall, ctoth, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained P112/query-mask lineage. This contribution is produced by Nick Petalas. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

Before: the all-field half-total theorem and a rational total-seven counterexample left the odd-total classification open. After: every one of 1,572,864 binary fitting matrices in the three profiles is enumerated, giving 1,716 rank-four optima and their complete local-group orbit partition.

An independent row-product enumeration computes rank from all 128 possible kernel vectors and enumerates every local invertible matrix by its determinant. It agrees on every rank histogram, canonical orbit, orbit size, stabilizer and channel label. Eight corrupted certificates reject; 7,200 comparisons check literal conjugation and involution. The completeness argument, all representatives and exact source pins are in `research/binary-c5-total-seven-orbits/`.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only: registered package and metadata/pin checks pass. Each registered check was timed separately: primary 1.424 s, independent 0.448 s, controls 1.907 s. Optimized direct replay passes in 1.326/0.445/1.926 s. These are local environment timings, not a speedup claim. Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes. A separate read-only internal audit found no mathematical or coverage flags. No external human or proof-kernel review is claimed.

Exact reproduction commands from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/binary-c5-total-seven-orbits
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/binary-c5-total-seven-orbits/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/binary-c5-total-seven-orbits/independent.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/binary-c5-total-seven-orbits/controls.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/binary-c5-total-seven-orbits --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 installation can replace the local interpreter path. Add `-O` to each direct scientific command for optimized replay. Expected markers are `PASS_BINARY_C5_TOTAL_SEVEN_ORBITS`, `PASS_BINARY_C5_INDEPENDENT_KERNEL_AND_FULL_GROUP`, `PASS_BINARY_C5_CONTROLS` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The canonical classification digest is `304003782bdccd32be10e12706a5a433b7a53d3b9fd58008213ca3fff14de5c5`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a complete finite binary certificate for the declared profiles, not an all-field classification or formal-kernel proof. Physical basis changes, source acquisition, queries/copies, dirty restoration, ownership/hosting, coefficient preparation, stock/precision, tapes, compiler and complete caller costs remain unprovided. No native supplier, new kappa, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. No Lean, Docker or selected cold replay was run.

## Open next questions

- Classify the total-seven profiles over larger finite fields or symbolically. Start with F3 and (3,1,1,1,1); the binary certificate gives no universal parameter classification.
- Bind one nonchannel representative to an actual producer/consumer and price its full physical basis/query/restoration bill. Rank four alone does not supply a useful decoder.

## Related open work

- #5868 studies induced Clebsch masks and query dimension versus edge sharing. This contribution classifies every optimal fitting matrix on three C5 payload profiles; it does not study or compare the Clebsch threshold.
- #3045 studies binary fitting-rank floors for square root-code decoders on geometric masks. The total-seven C5 orbit domain here is different; no common numerical result is asserted.
- #1037 studies characteristic-two asymmetric block-fitting rank for actual Turyn profiles. This certificate concerns local-similarity classes on a different fixed mask, without a Turyn or physical-cost comparison.

The full live open-PR inventory and recent handoffs were checked before committing. No open total-seven C5 classification was found. These checks exclude unpublished work and do not establish global literature priority.
